name: loomcli
description: The Loom CLI application framework. Designed to make developing beautiful command-line tools for humans and agents intuitive.

scripts.check: pnpm run build && vp check && pnpm run check:types && pnpm run loom changelog check
scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/textstat/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/jsonkit/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/loom/tsconfig.json
